question: Who among the following founded an organisation called the Indian Association, in 1876, along with Surendranath Banerjee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ananda Mohan Bose**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Ananda Mohan Bose** founded the Indian Association along with Surendranath Banerjee in 1876.
 
• Ananda Mohan Bose **was an Indian politician, academic, social reformer, and lawyer during the British Raj.**
 
• In 1874**, he became the first Indian Wrangler (a student who has completed the third year of the Mathematical Tripos with first-class honours) of the Cambridge University**.
 
• He was** also a prominent religious leader of Brahmoism and with Sivanath Sastri a leading light of Adi Dharm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Association:-

 
 
• **Indian Association was a political organization that aimed to promote the interests of the Indian community** and to work towards the attainment of political rights and freedom from British rule.
 
• The Indian **Association merged with the Indian National Congress in 1886.** 
 
• Indian Association played a significant role in the Indian National Movement and was one of the first organizations to demand self-government and representation for Indians in the British colonial administration.
 
 
 
• Surendranath Banerjee:-
 
 
• He was a** prominent Indian nationalist leader a**nd a member of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was also a journalist, lawyer, and a member of the Bengal Legislative Council.
